instruction: Set Vim as the default text editor on your Ubuntu system.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Vim as the default text editor on Ubuntu. The evaluator uses a custom getter that queries xdg-mime for all common text MIME types (plain text, C, Python, shell scripts, etc.) and returns the most common default application. The metric checks if the result includes 'vim.desktop'. This task is similar in difficulty and complexity to the original VLC task, requiring the same type of system configuration change.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts default text editor by querying xdg-mime for multiple text MIME types and returning the most common default application
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - directly accesses rules.get('include') without incorrect nested access patterns
Expected value 'vim.desktop' is semantically correct for Vim's desktop entry on Ubuntu
Complete coverage: evaluator fully verifies the instruction requirement of making Vim the default text editor
Data flow is correct: getter returns application name string, metric checks if 'vim.desktop' is included in the result
Edge case handling: getter returns 'unknown' when no defaults are set, which correctly fails verification
